nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Report. Prefer facts. Tolerate feelings if they affected the facts.

choices.text: Fragment secured. Cover holding. Maris is… complicated.
Contact made. Intel incomplete. I didn't blow it — mostly.
I prioritised the person over the drawer.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Complicated is fine. Verified discrepancy is better. You get to keep both the shoes and the dignity tonight. Dismissed.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Mostly is a word handlers hate and humans need. We'll work the gaps. Don't get attached to gaps.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Then the drawer waits. People don't. Clinical note: that was either wisdom or a career-limiting crush. Sleep on which.
